retrievalProfile.description: A three-panel vertical triptych featuring portraits where subjects hold small photographic prints over their eyes to create a layered identity effect.
triggerTerms: triptych portrait with polaroid eye masks
vertical panel collage with halftone texture

recipe.visualDefinition: A vertical triptych layout separated by thick black gutters, featuring three monochrome or desaturated portraits. Each subject holds a small, rectangular color-tinted photograph (resembling a Polaroid) directly over their eyes, creating a 'mask' effect. The overall aesthetic is grainy with a visible halftone or newsprint texture.
coreVisualRelationships: Vertical repetition of three distinct subjects
Contrast between desaturated backgrounds and warm-toned eye inserts
Alignment of the 'eye-mask' photographs across the horizontal axis
Heavy black borders framing the individual panels and the footer
coreInvariants: Rectangular photo inserts covering the eyes
Dark footer bar for secondary typography

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Three medium-shot portraits, each centered within its respective vertical panel.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The three rectangular eye-mask photos which create a horizontal focal line across the center.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Left-to-right scanning across the three panels, then downward to the footer text.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Dense composition with subjects filling the panels; negative space is restricted to the black gutters and footer.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Desaturated grey and black for the main portraits and background.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Warm amber and yellow tones within the eye-mask photo inserts.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Muted coral or salmon red used for specific typographic characters.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High contrast between dark shadows and light skin tones, with low overall saturation except for the eye-masks.
paletteRestrictions: Limit to greyscale, amber, and salmon red

letterConstructionRules: Extremely high aspect ratio (tall and narrow)
characterSpecificRedesigns: Occasional characters filled with accent color to break rhythm

composition.position: top right of the third panel
centered in the bottom black footer

treatment.fill: white with alternating salmon red characters

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: A tall, aggressive condensed sans for the primary brand paired with a more spaced-out, lowercase sans for the title.

candidateDirections.reason: Captures the extreme verticality and weight of the primary text.
Provides the sturdy, industrial feel for the footer text.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a triptych of three vertical panels separated by black bars. Each panel contains a grainy, desaturated portrait of a man holding a small rectangular color photo over his eyes. Add a thick black footer bar at the bottom.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Apply extra-condensed sans-serif text in the top right of the third panel in salmon red. In the bottom footer, place lowercase sans-serif text with wide tracking, alternating white and salmon red for specific letters.

verificationChecks: Are there three distinct vertical panels?
Is the footer text widely spaced?

adjustableVariables: Tint color of the eye-mask photos
mustRedesign: Specific facial features of the subjects

mustAchieve: Consistent halftone texture across all panels
Precise alignment of the eye-mask rectangles
Stark contrast between the black framing and the imagery

postGenerationChecks: Confirm the triptych structure is maintained with black dividers.
Ensure the eye-mask photos look like physical inserts, not digital blurs.
Check that the typography in the footer has extreme letter-spacing.
Verify the desaturated color palette with specific warm accents.
recipe.reuseFormula: Triptych + Eye-Mask Collage + Halftone Texture + Condensed Typography
